Name: farmerchip's Custom Winter Star Gifts
Author: farmerchip
Description:
There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10024]an existing mod[/url]﻿ with a similar concept, but this one was written completely from scratch and developed independently.

[i]Note: This is my first C# Stardew Valley mod, so there may be a lot of bugs![/i]

Sprites used in the screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Configure specific items (and/or quantities) that you'd like to receive as gifts from NPCs
[*]Different gift pools for "Liked" (4-7 hearts) and "Loved" (8+ hearts) friendship levels. NPCs with less than 4 hearts will receive a set of basic gifts.
[*]Visual configuration menu ([b]F9[/b]; configurable) to make it easy to pick your preferred gifts without needing to know item IDs
[*]All mod settings, including the keybind and advanced text fields, are accessible through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)
[*]Developer console commands for opening the visual menu, resetting settings, and testing gift distribution
[/list]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]﻿[/b]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, but recommended)
[*]Download this mod
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
See [url=https://github.com/chippokiddo/sdvmods/wiki/Custom-Winter-Star-Gifts]documentation﻿[/url] on the GitHub wiki.
See [url=https://github.com/chippokiddo/sdvmods]source code[/url]﻿﻿ on the GitHub repo.
